title: 总复习 + 全流程模拟
goal: 复习全部 24 天内容；完整演练：酒店入住 → 房间出问题 → 问路 → 拜访客户。
tips: 先把生词本里答错次数最多的词句过一遍，再做总复习测验，目标正确率 80% 以上。
出发前把最常用的句子加到生词本，旅途中打开“速查”或“生词本”随时看、随时播放。
真到了现场，听不懂就说 Sorry, could you say that again? 说慢点、写下来、看地图——你已经全都会了。

dialogue.title: 全流程模拟：从酒店到客户公司

lines.en: Good evening. Are you checking in?
lines.zh: 晚上好。您是办理入住吗？

lines.en: Yes. I have a reservation under the name Zhou.
lines.zh: 是的。我用“周”这个名字预订了。

lines.en: Could I see your passport and a credit card, please?
lines.zh: 请出示您的护照和一张信用卡。

lines.en: Here you are. Is breakfast included?
Yes, from six thirty to ten. Your room is fifteen-oh-eight.
lines.zh: 含，六点半到十点。您的房间是1508。

lines.en: Front desk. How can I help you?
Hi, this is room fifteen-oh-eight. There's no hot water in the shower.
lines.zh: 你好，这里是1508房。淋浴没有热水。

lines.en: I'm sorry about that. We'll send someone up right away.
lines.zh: 很抱歉，我们马上派人上去。

lines.en: Excuse me. How do I get to Victoria Tower?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，请问维多利亚大厦怎么走？

lines.en: Go straight for two blocks and turn right. It's across from the bank.
lines.zh: 直走两个街区然后右转，在银行对面。

lines.en: Two blocks, then right. Thanks a lot.
lines.zh: 两个街区，然后右转。非常感谢。

lines.en: Hello, you must be Mr. Zhou. I'm Tom Miller. Nice to meet you.
lines.zh: 你好，您一定是周先生吧。我是汤姆·米勒，很高兴见到您。

lines.en: Nice to meet you too, Tom. Here's my business card.
lines.zh: 我也很高兴见到你，汤姆。这是我的名片。

lines.en: Thank you. How was your trip?
Long, but everything went well. Thanks for asking.
lines.zh: 挺长的，不过一切顺利。谢谢关心。

lines.en: Great. Shall we start the meeting?
lines.zh: 太好了。我们开始开会吧？

lines.en: Sure. First, I'll give a short presentation.
lines.zh: 好的。首先我做一个简短的介绍。
